name: Civil Service
overview: The narrative of Joseph's service in Genesis 39 illustrates key principles of civil service grounded in God's providence and blessing. Joseph's faithful and diligent service as an overseer in Potiphar's household led to prosperity and trust, demonstrating that God honors integrity and competence in positions of responsibility. This account underscores the importance of merit and divine favor in civil appointments, as well as the positive influence a godly servant can have on those they serve.
